Registration and locations can be found [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMCEurope2025) European locations may be added until **September 5th 23:59 UTC** so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates).
